01-grants.focus: Automated market making, decentralized order books, delta-neutral yield vaults, and algorithmic execution bots on Solana.
tracks: Delta-neutral funding rate arbitrage vaults with automated collateral rebalancing.
High-frequency algorithmic market-making bots and keeper infrastructure for open order books.
Open-source Python and Rust SDKs, WebSocket pub/sub clients, and CLI trading utilities.
Real-time liquidation bots and onchain risk monitors with automated alerting.
01-grants.applicant_fit: Quantitative developers, Solana Rust engineers, and DeFi researchers with proven experience in low-latency trading infrastructure.
01-grants.milestone_structure: Tranche 1 (30%) on testnet deployment with paper trading; Tranche 2 (40%) upon security review and audit completion; Tranche 3 (30%) following public mainnet launch with verifiable volume.
01-grants.deliverables: Documented GitHub repository under MIT or Apache 2.0 license, clean integration test suite, deployment scripts, and public user documentation.

0g-growth.focus: Modular artificial intelligence architecture, ultra-high-throughput data availability (DA), decentralized key-value storage, and verifiable onchain inference.
tracks: Layer 2 rollup data availability integrations leveraging 0G's modular consensus and DA layer.
Decentralized storage nodes and indexing infrastructure for large language model weights and multimodal datasets.
Autonomous AI agent frameworks, model alignment networks, and zero-knowledge inference verification.
Decentralized training checkpoint networks and collaborative machine learning pipelines.
0g-growth.applicant_fit: Distributed systems engineers, AI/ML researchers, and rollup infrastructure teams building data-intensive decentralized applications.
0g-growth.milestone_structure: Tranche 1 (25%) on architecture spec and testnet node integration; Tranche 2 (35%) on benchmark validation achieving target throughput; Tranche 3 (40%) on production mainnet deployment.
0g-growth.deliverables: Open-source codebase, comprehensive benchmark reports, public documentation, Dockerized node deployment configurations, and automated CI pipelines.

3327-grants.focus: Novel Web3 protocols, decentralized research, cryptography tooling, zero-knowledge proofs, and sovereign collective infrastructure.
tracks: Applied zero-knowledge primitives, succinct verification schemes, and cryptographic libraries.
Decentralized autonomous organization governance frameworks and coordination primitives.
Smart contract development tooling, formal verification templates, and EVM testing utilities.
Privacy-preserving communication channels, decentralized identity, and censorship-resistant networking.
3327-grants.applicant_fit: Independent Web3 researchers, cryptographers, and distributed systems hackers who value collective autonomy and deep technical exploration.
3327-grants.milestone_structure: Initial funding (30%) on proof-of-concept spec and architecture review; Mid-term tranche (40%) on functional testnet implementation; Final tranche (30%) on peer review and production release.
3327-grants.deliverables: Public research paper or technical specification, open-source code repository with high test coverage, and reproducible benchmark suites.

aave-grants.focus: Aave protocol development, cross-chain liquidity routing, risk modeling, collateral integrations, and GHO stablecoin utility.
tracks: Novel collateral onboarding modules, isolated lending markets, and automated liquidation engines.
GHO stablecoin adoption tooling, cross-chain minting primitives, and payment streaming interfaces.
Onchain financial risk analytics, bad debt monitoring dashboards, and real-time vault telemetry.
Developer SDKs, smart contract integrations, and consumer frontends expanding Aave v3 accessibility.
aave-grants.applicant_fit: Smart contract engineers, quantitative risk analysts, and DeFi builders with deep familiarity with Aave protocol architecture and Solidity.
aave-grants.milestone_structure: Milestone 1 (30%) on protocol specification and initial contract implementation; Milestone 2 (40%) on testnet deployment and third-party audit; Milestone 3 (30%) on mainnet verification.
aave-grants.deliverables: Audited smart contracts, comprehensive documentation, integration guides, unit and invariant test suites, and open-source frontend components.

abey-foundation.focus: High-throughput smart contract development, cross-chain bridge architecture, DeFi protocols, and decentralized enterprise solutions on the ABEYChain.
tracks: Scalable decentralized finance primitives including DEXs, lending protocols, and algorithmic assets.
Cross-chain interoperability bridges connecting ABEYChain with EVM networks and Bitcoin.
Decentralized identity, supply chain tracking, and real-world asset verification on ABEY.
Developer tooling, indexing services, and developer-friendly RPC infrastructure.
abey-foundation.applicant_fit: Full-stack blockchain developers and enterprise integration specialists looking to deploy scalable decentralized applications.
abey-foundation.milestone_structure: Tranche 1 (30%) on technical design approval and testnet deployment; Tranche 2 (40%) on protocol audit; Tranche 3 (30%) on live mainnet adoption metrics.
abey-foundation.deliverables: Open-source smart contracts, developer integration guides, automated tests, and production monitoring dashboards.

acala-grants.focus: Polkadot parachain DeFi, aUSD ecosystem integrations, cross-consensus messaging (XCM), and EVM+ smart contract tooling.
tracks: Decentralized liquid staking derivatives, yield strategies, and cross-chain asset management.
XCM-based interoperability workflows connecting Acala liquidity with other Polkadot and Kusama parachains.
Substrate runtime modules, EVM+ compatible developer libraries, and indexing infrastructure.
Decentralized identity, governance tooling, and institutional compliance bridges.
acala-grants.applicant_fit: Rust Substrate developers and Solidity smart contract engineers passionate about cross-chain DeFi ecosystems.
acala-grants.milestone_structure: Milestone 1 (35%) on runtime or contract deployment to Mandala testnet; Milestone 2 (35%) on security audit; Milestone 3 (30%) on parachain mainnet deployment.
acala-grants.deliverables: Clean Substrate pallet or EVM+ contract codebase, XCM integration tests, technical documentation, and user tutorials.

aethir-fund.focus: Decentralized enterprise GPU computing, AI model training, real-time cloud gaming, and autonomous agent inference infrastructure.
tracks: Enterprise AI model serving, distributed LLM fine-tuning, and low-latency inference routing on Aethir GPUs.
Cloud gaming rendering pipelines, interactive streaming engines, and Web3 virtual world backends.
Autonomous onchain agent compute orchestration and decentralized compute marketplaces.
Developer tooling, scheduling SDKs, and benchmarking suites evaluating distributed GPU clusters.
aethir-fund.applicant_fit: AI/ML engineering teams, game studios, and decentralized compute builders with production workloads ready to migrate or scale.
aethir-fund.milestone_structure: Stage 1 (25%) on workload profiling and testnet compute allocation; Stage 2 (40%) on containerized deployment and performance benchmarking; Stage 3 (35%) on commercial scaling.
aethir-fund.deliverables: Production container recipes, API integration benchmarks, public documentation, open-source SDK contributions, and milestone verification logs.
